title: Keymaster House Admission
objective: Adapt and admit the qualified minimum Keymaster resident as sanitized credential metadata/health/policy intelligence without secret locators, secret access, provider calls, rotation or credential mutation.
laws: Resident Keymaster stores and returns no secret values and no secret locators.
Secret resolution, sealed use, provider validation, store, replace, revoke and rotation are out of scope.
Trust Canal remains approval authority for consequential credential actions.
Switchyard may consume sanitized health only and cannot resolve credentials.
Rhea may consume sanitized health only; no auto-rotation.
Kronos may read readiness evidence but owns no credential custody.
House admission requires manifest + Book + component contract + Atlas/Mnemosyne + exact T590 proof.
